scope.frame: B1656's frame: its channel norm and its end parameter L
scope.object: the norm's change under S and the end's compensating shift; the invariant end parameter
scope.hypotheses: the derivation from the fibre's rescaling and the kernel's weight one; checked at three tau and three characteristics; the residues R_s and the frame's outputs under the thread average not examined

claim_one_line: THE END'S SHIFT UNDER S IS THE CHANNEL NORM'S TAU-TERM (B1724's numerical note, closed): S rescales the fibre, the kernel has weight one, and the regularisation's excised disc rescales by |tau|, so N(c', -1/tau) = N(c, tau) - 2 pi log|tau| (checked to 1.9e-9 at nine cases; 0.33 to 1.27 without the shift), which the end's L -> L + log|tau| cancels; with B1919, L~ = L + (1/2) log Im tau - (gamma + log pi) is SL(2,Z)-invariant and 2 pi L + c_s = 2 pi L~ + F_u. No input removed. 0 of 19.
